title: Outlook: 1-year and 2-year offline email sync options in new Outlook for Windows
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing and existing offline control are supported. The updated release notes do not announce the longer windows, and targeted searches found no documented admin control for their duration.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: No admin UI setting or API for controlling the new Outlook offline duration is documented in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: new Outlook Windows offline Days of email to save admin policy sync window Set-OwaMailboxPolicy; new Outlook Days of email to save offline admin sync window policy Graph API 1 year 2 years. Opened policy-management, EAC policy properties and Set-OwaMailboxPolicy; no duration control found.

claims.claim: The EAC route is Roles > Outlook web app policies > policy > Details > Access > Manage access > Edit access > Offline access.
claims.quote: go to **Roles** > **Outlook web app policies** ... select the policy ... **Details** flyout ... **Access**: Select **Manage access**. In the **Edit access** flyout ... **Offline access**

claims.claim: Set-OwaMailboxPolicy -Identity <policy name> -OfflineEnabledWin $false disables offline capabilities for the policy.
claims.quote: The Identity parameter specifies the Outlook on the web mailbox policy that you want to modify. ... Name ... $false: Users can't manage offline capabilities in Outlook. No items are saved to the user's device. Previously save items are deleted.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: OfflineEnabledWin allows or blocks offline use of new Outlook for Windows.
claims.quote: The `OfflineEnabledWin` parameter on the **Set-OwaMailboxPolicy** cmdlet allows or blocks the new Outlook for Windows from being used offline.

claims.claim: OfflineEnabledWin is an availability switch, not a duration setting or a selective block on longer windows.
claims.quote: The OfflineEnabledWin parameter specifies whether offline capabilities are available ... $true: Users can manage offline capabilities in Outlook. ... $false: Users can't manage offline capabilities in Outlook. No items are saved to the user's device.

claims.claim: Microsoft's classic Outlook sync-window guidance warns that raising the value for hundreds or more clients can adversely affect network bandwidth.
claims.quote: When GPO changes SyncWindowSetting to any higher value, Outlook will do a full OST resynchronization when the new value applies. ... Applying a higher value to hundreds or more clients at the same time could adversely affect available network bandwidth.
